standard.summary: 梯度防护在标准梯度裁剪（max_grad_norm）之外提供额外的梯度调节策略：AGC（Adaptive Gradient Clipping）和 Centralized Gradient。
standard.effect: gradient_guard_strategy='agc' 按参数范数的比例裁剪梯度，防止大参数层主导更新。'centralized' 减去梯度均值。'agc_centralized' 两者结合。
standard.whenToUse: loss spike 频繁或梯度不稳定时。AGC 在 rank collapse 诊断中有用。
standard.avoidWhen: 训练稳定时不需要。额外计算开销。

optionDescriptions.agc: 自适应裁一下异常大梯度。

standard_en.summary: Gradient guarding offers extra gradient conditioning beyond standard clipping (max_grad_norm): AGC (Adaptive Gradient Clipping) and Centralized Gradient.
standard_en.effect: gradient_guard_strategy='agc' clips gradients in proportion to the parameter norm, stopping large layers from dominating the update. 'centralized' subtracts the gradient mean. 'agc_centralized' does both.
standard_en.whenToUse: When loss spikes are frequent or gradients are unstable. AGC is also useful in rank-collapse diagnosis.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Not needed while training is stable. It costs extra computation.

advanced.principle: AGC: 对每个参数组，如果 ||g|| > clip_factor × ||θ||，则 g' = g × (clip_factor × ||θ|| / ||g||)。这确保更新幅度与参数尺度成比例。Centralized: g' = g - mean(g)，消除梯度中的共同方向（类似 LayerNorm 效果）。max_grad_norm 是全局裁剪，AGC 是 per-layer 自适应裁剪。
advanced.intervention: 在 backward() 后、optimizer.step() 前对梯度进行变换。
advanced.expectedImpact: 减少 loss spike 约 30-50%。稳定训练过程。
advanced.tradeoffs: gradient_guard_agc_clip_factor 和 gradient_guard_agc_eps 控制 AGC 的裁剪强度和数值稳定性。

advanced_en.principle: AGC: per parameter group, if ||g|| > clip_factor × ||θ||, then g' = g × (clip_factor × ||θ|| / ||g||), keeping update magnitude proportional to parameter scale. Centralized: g' = g - mean(g), removing the gradient's common direction (LayerNorm-like effect). max_grad_norm is global clipping; AGC is per-layer adaptive clipping.
advanced_en.intervention: Transforms gradients after backward() and before optimizer.step().
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Reduces loss spikes by roughly 30-50%. Stabilizes training.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: gradient_guard_agc_clip_factor and gradient_guard_agc_eps control AGC's clip strength and numerical stability.
